ModMetaData.name: SloppyMods - Human Resources
ModMetaData.author: SloppyMod
ModMetaData.description:
Build 0.9.3
An HR manager for your colony. Adds an HR button to the bottom bar with four pages:
- Time use: how each colonist spent the last hours or days, by kind of work, sleep, recreation, idling and walking. - Job advisor: suggested work priorities for each colonist from skill, passions, traits, genes and health, with an Apply button and an optional daily review. - Workload: which kinds of work are keeping up, falling behind or not being worked at all, tracked over two days, with a click-through to the work that is waiting. - Job titles: your own named templates of work priorities. Assign up to three to a colonist, see who suits a title best, and keep a library of titles that is shared between all your games.
Also adds a Title column to the Work tab and an optional badge on colonist portraits showing what each colonist is doing.
Works with [FSF] Complex Jobs and Vanilla Skills Expanded when they are installed. Early build: expect rough edges.
